$doc: UI theme + HUD layout. Colours here feed CSS custom properties at boot, so restyling the whole game is a config edit.
$fonts: Each stack ends in a chain of system faces that cover Japanese, Simplified Chinese and Cyrillic, because the game ships in six languages and the display face does not have those glyphs. Without them a browser picks per-character fallbacks and a Japanese menu comes out in three different weights. Substituting a real webfont is a change to these three strings and nothing else.

theme.fontDisplay: 'Cinzel', 'Times New Roman', 'Yu Mincho', 'Hiragino Mincho ProN', 'Source Han Serif SC', 'Songti SC', serif
theme.fontBody: 'Inter', system-ui, 'Yu Gothic UI', 'Hiragino Sans', 'Noto Sans JP', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans SC', sans-serif
theme.fontMono: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Noto Sans Mono CJK JP', monospace

coins.$doc: The run purse. In a run it only appears once you have actually picked something up - a permanent 0 would be noise. The lobby wardrobe always shows the banked total.

chat.$doc: Text chat. Lines fade after `messageSeconds` so the log is not a permanent panel in a game about looking at the dark; the whole backlog comes back while the box is open.

tutorial.$doc: The corner tutorial line. Deliberately only the essentials - anything a player can work out by trying it is not in here.
tutorial.$kinds: A `task` tip stays up until the player does the thing, and they are offered in the order listed. A `flash` tip appears when its trigger fires and goes away on its own. Only ever ONE is on screen; the rest wait.
tutorial.$ids: `id` is both the locale key (`tutorial.<id>`) and the trigger the code reports - the set is fixed, so this list orders and dresses the tips rather than inventing them. `keys` are action ids from input.json whose caps fill the string's {key} gap.
tutorial.$gapSeconds: Quiet between one tip leaving and the next arriving, so two in a row do not read as one line changing under you.

menus.$doc: The main menu's backdrop. `screenshots` runs the slideshow below; anything else leaves the menu on its flat gradient.

background.$doc: Stills from the game, cross-faded behind the main menu. `folder` is served from assets/, so swapping the set is dropping files in assets/ui/menu/ and editing `images` - see assets/ui/menu/README.md. Order is shuffled at boot, so nobody gets the same first frame every launch.
background.$drift: How far a still creeps while it is up, as a fraction of its size. 0 stops the drift entirely.
background.$dim: How much black is laid over the stills, 0..1. The menu's text contrast lives here.
background.$grain: Film grain over the whole backdrop, 0..1. 0 turns the layer off.
